snippet.title: KEROGEN - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Lost at sea, the small crew of the ATLAS calls for aid. Something is stirring beneath the waves.

KEROGEN is a first-person horror mystery set aboard an oil tanker lost in the Black Sea. Take on the role of a forsaken drone operator tasked with dredging corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare as tensions among the desperate crew begin to escalate.

Explore deep-sea industrial environments, piece together half-recovered memories and experience the story of a protagonist torn between two bodies. Above you, Elmsfire dances in the clouds. Below, black beasts stir in the waves.

Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

Wishlist KEROGEN now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529130/KEROGEN/

Visit KEROGEN at gamescom 2026 on Wednesday in Hall 10.2 and Thursday in Hall 4.1, Booth A061 at the Gaming Area NRW.
